caption_draft:
You can practise DSA for free on these 5 sites.

LeetCode — https://leetcode.com/studyplan/top-interview-150/ — 150 classic interview questions
Codeforces — https://codeforces.com/problemset — Problems sorted by difficulty
CodeChef — https://www.codechef.com/ — Weekly contests on the free plan
HackerRank — https://www.hackerrank.com/domains/data-structures — Practice sorted by data structure
GeeksforGeeks — https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/explore — 2,500+ practice problems

Save this for the semester and send it to the friend who wants to start DSA this week.
